entities.summary: Artemiy Vladimirovich Artsikhovsky was a Russian Soviet archaeologist and historian, professor, head of the department of archaeology of the Moscow State University, the discoverer of birch bark manuscripts in Novgorod. Corresponding member of the USSR Academy of Sciences, recipient of the USSR State Prize.
